'''Scar''' is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]] that makes his first appearance as an NPC in [[Version 1.0]] during the {{Quest|Ominous Star}}.

His strong belief is that to attain the next level of human evolution, individuals must absorb the [[Tacet Discord]] into themselves, engaging in a transformative struggle. Scar perceives those who view [[the Lament]] as an apocalypse of boundless destruction as having a shallow understanding of the world. To him, the Tacet Discords brought forth by the Lament represent a self-regulating system of evolution, of accelerated change, as their physiologies rapidly shift to accommodate new living conditions. The Lament, by extension, is an era of rebirth, the era to wipe the slate clean, to start anew.

Scar sees the potential in [[Rover]] to absorb the recently revived [[Threnodian]] [[Crownless]], making them a prime candidate for the organization. Scar’s mentorship involves guiding individuals through the process, believing the key to unlocking unique and twisted abilities in those who prove worthy lies in the Tacet Discords.

==Appareance==
Scar is a tall and slim young man with spiky white hair that is red inside and numerous scars on his face, one on his right side of his face with another cutting vertically through his left eye, as well a horizontal on his left cheek. His right eye is red and his left eye is grey. He also has golden earrings shaped like ankhs. His attire consists of a grey jumpsuit under a opened and three-collared red jacket that is unbottoned with some  blades of black knives in the pockets, a type of black battery holding another ankh-like earring kept with a long black belt across the chest and a black left arm. His pants are white with red endings kept with black belts with a silver fivel and opened black buttons, which is also flared. Apart from this, Scar also wears black gloves with red endings in the fingers and black boots with red metallic parts.

Described as a Goat Grim Reaper, as Aberrant Nightmare, Scar appears to be a extremely large and muscular wendigo-like creature with dark grey skin covered in white fur, bandaged legs and arms and a light grey skull-like head with a dark grey jaw alongside its earrings. Six bioluminescent eyes that have yellow sclera with black pupils that cover its trademark scars who are light grey. As well some small, pointy black and long black ram-like horns that have white stains with his white hair now being longer with purple ending tips alongside his fingers and endings of its jacket who are now torn as a result of empowering himself, as well more growing white fur in its arms.

==Personality==
Scar appears to be a charismatic, yet opportunistic and manipulative individual who is passionate about his ideals, actively seeking out individuals whom he deems worthy to join Fractsidus and undertake the transformative process with the Tacet Discord. Scar opposes Huanglong’s efforts to suppress the Tacet Discord. His idea of a new world after harrowing turmoil reflects a twisted sense of evolution. He encourages individuals, especially Rover, whom he views as a kindred black lamb, doomed to stand out unfavorably from the rest, to join Fractsidus. His smile is very wide and can be described as borderline psychopathic, matching his own description of himself.

He is also shown to be very cunning when discussing his ideals, which can be shown when Rover and Scar share their first encounter. Scar also introduces himself as a "cruel and twisted maniac". He presents himself as very honest and genuine despite capturing [[Yangyang]] in an attempt to earn Rover's trust.

Scar tells the story of Qichi Village using a “fable” about a [[The Shepherd|shepherd]], a flock of lambs, and a black lamb as an analogy—indicating part of his playful and creative side. He also appears to value multiple perspectives, making him a very conscientious individual. Scar seems to value banter and games, as he didn’t want the Rover to cheat without looking for answers first. However, he then states that the people who succumbed to their grief (the lambs who sacrificed the black lamb) “had it coming”. Scar also claims that he self-identifies with the black lamb, being a rebel against the shepherd who breaks the rules.

===Resonance===
He is a [[Resonator]], and his [[Tacet Mark]] is located across his neck.

His Resonance ability involves teleportation and the manipulation of space, as well as the creation of Elysium, a barrier that can only break under coordinated attacks from both sides.

==Story==
===History===
When Scar was a child, his mother told him many fairy tales, described as being the only tender moments in their family, though he never believed in her versions. <ref>https://wutheringwaves.fandom.com/wiki/Depths_of_Illusive_Realm/Tokens</ref>

According to official case files of the Qichi Village incident, the perpetrators were brought to justice and the most of the townspeople were able to be safely relocated. He is believed to be the 'big brother' mentioned by the unknown girl, and as there are no mentions of her in the files, he is believed to have taken her away.
